validation module¶

Data validation module.

This module provides utility functions for validating user input and defines standard error constants to prevent magic string occurrences.

validation.validate_email(email: str) → list¶

Validates the format of an email address.

This function checks if the provided email string matches a standard email regular expression. It handles empty inputs and invalid patterns.

Parameters:

email (str) – The email address string to be validated.

Returns:

A list containing error strings if validation fails.

Returns an empty list if the email is perfectly valid.

Return type:

list
